summary: DueByte 0.3.61 fixes wallet history verification on slow connections after compact-state bootstrap. Timed-out header requests retry in smaller verified windows; invalid proofs still stop verification. Existing chain, wallets, balances, validator rules and issuance settings are unchanged. Home60 updates automatically; Linux Server updates manually. No issuance, warmup or mainnet exchange is activated. Windows executable is not Microsoft-code-signed; verify the signed DueByte update channel. The candidate notice inside the immutable archive is superseded by this release notice.
